requirements: R1: Fix exception swallowing in JwtAuthenticationFilter by explicitly handling or propagating failures during token revocation and role resolution instead of returning faked success values

slices.title: Fix exception swallowing in JwtAuthenticationFilter
slices.jtbd: When implementing the JwtAuthenticationFilter fix for this epic, I want to remove try/catch blocks that swallow failures, so that unauthorized requests are properly blocked instead of faking success.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a failed token revocation check or persistent role resolution failure
When the JwtAuthenticationFilter processes the request
Then the exception is not swallowed, no plausible-looking faked success is returned, and automated tests verify that the request correctly fails
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero unauthorized requests passed due to swallowed exceptions
